dropped: blob payloads (full tool arguments and responses)
the home directory and repository path, in slash and backslash forms
the account username, case-insensitively, anywhere it appears
retained: the repository's own name, where it appears in commands
args_summary free text, credential-scrubbed and truncated at record time
redaction.verified: Every written line was searched for the username after redaction; lines_with_residual_username is that count and must be 0. This checks one known identifier, not every possible one — a scrubber is a filter, not a proof, so read the output before publishing it.
